title: Two brains: a swarmer against an out-boxer
note: Brains read their opponent's habits, imagine the exchange in the Referee, and pick among good scripts by their style's values. Each has a tell: the swarmer always opens by closing in from beyond Close; the out-boxer always opens by backing off at Close or nearer. Try other styles: swarmer, out-boxer, slugger, counterpuncher, boxer-puncher, aerialist, reader; skills: novice, adept, master.
